separation.builder: Existing page-change builder opportunity claim remains the sole builder authority surface.
separation.verifier: Existing independent page-change verifier claim plus coordination/executions/<work_item_id>/VERIFY.json remain separate from builder authority.
separation.human_review: Public metadata/result stays candidate evidence; this adapter cannot mark Human Accepted, SERVED, promoted, or CURRENT.

authority_boundary: The public envelope is discovery metadata only. It never grants worker authority; existing page-change opportunity claim remains the authority surface.
unresolved_boundary: Private execution context still requires an authenticated non-public resolver after the existing authority claim; this slot deliberately does not publish or invent that store.
